summary: Identified five qualifying multifamily sales comps in Tampa (event dates 2026-02-05 to 2026-06-09), each 78–174 units, stabilized, fee-simple, single-asset, unrelated-party, within 8 miles, and with known positive USD consideration. Ranked by proximity: R5709 (0.8 mi), R1935 (1.03 mi, amended consideration), R8685 (1.26 mi), R1029 (1.49 mi), and R4639 (1.72 mi). Created a comp-grid XLSX with citations reflecting these selections. Several records were excluded due to wrong size unit, size out of range, missing consideration, minority interest, redevelopment, listing status, related-party, distance beyond 8 miles, portfolio-unallocated pricing, or publication after the 2026-08-31 cutoff.
limitations: All facts rely solely on supplied extracts and updates; no external corroboration.
Unsigned draft update for R1029 (U-R1029-3) and post-cutoff executed amendment for R8685 (U-R8685-2) were not applied; if controlling evidence changes, pricing/PPU could differ.
Event R4014 (published after cutoff) was excluded; inclusion in a later run would affect comp availability and rankings.
Distance values are taken as given; no geospatial validation performed.
Price-per-unit is a simple total price divided by reported unit count; no adjustment for unit mix, condition variance or concessions.
